description: A Google ADK agent with thinking enabled, answered with reasoning plus text.
notes: google-adk 2.14.0. The runner sets GOOGLE_API_KEY, so the Gemini client uses the API-key path and does not probe the metadata server. Gemini.base_url is the mock. Cloud Trace export is started only by the ADK CLI server, which this scenario does not run. ADK_EXPERIMENTAL_TELEMETRY is false. ADK_TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION_OPT_IN is 1. ADK_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT_IN_SPANS is true. Thinking is enabled with include_thoughts and thinking_budget 64. Covers D113 (ADK token semantics): gen_ai.usage.output_tokens is 20, the sum of candidates_token_count 14 and thoughts_token_count 6, and gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens is 6. call_llm also sets gen_ai.usage.experimental.reasoning_tokens_limit 64. Event ids come from set_id_provider, a counter of capture-N. The session id is session-1 and the user id is user-1. prices.json has no Gemini model row.

message.text: It is 18 °C and sunny in Paris.
